en.html:
Muramasa II"What sort of person she was, I knew. Knowing it, I accepted her as my pilot and formed the bond..."
Muramasa《Wh-why!》
Muramasa II"Third... Since the seal released you, Yamato's history you have studied?"
Muramasa《...》
Muramasa II"Astonishing thing... difficult to believe. After the conflict of the Northern and Southern Courts, after the near-extermination we Muramasa brought, the peace built on all that—"
Muramasa II"Even a hundred years it did not last, apparently."
Muramasa《............The Sengoku period?》
Muramasa II"That is what they call it. Only a few decades passed, it seems, and again chaos, no less than the Northern and Southern Courts..."
Muramasa II"What do you make of that?"
Muramasa《............》
Muramasa II"Not enough."
Muramasa II"ENOUGH IT WAS NOT!!"
Muramasa II"So much war! So much slaughter! Such a vast hell!"
Muramasa II"Even that was nowhere near enough to teach people the ugliness of war, its stupidity, its self-righteousness! In violence, good and evil always cancel each other. In war there is no justice. This truth Muramasa showed, and immediately they forgot!"
Muramasa II"Again into self-righteousness they plunged. Not even bored of themselves! Fighting, killing... More time they wasted in pointless wars than in the age of the two Courts!!"
Muramasa《M-Maa...》
Muramasa II"Human stupidity I took too lightly."
Muramasa II"We tsurugi have our souls hammered into armour. Our ideal does not change. But this brain made of flesh—carve truth into it, and it seems to forget while the carving is still going on."
Muramasa《So... toh what? Do the whole thing AGAIN?! That is your answer?!》
Muramasa II"Yes."
Muramasa《That defeats the whole purpose! Nana would never want this!》
Muramasa《He wanted to spread the lesson of the Balance of Good and Evil, stop fighting before it started—》
Muramasa II"Very shallow thinking you are doing."
Muramasa《............》

Muramasa II"Just now you said it, no? The Founder's failure, something like that. ...That also you have misunderstood."
Muramasa II"My father failed in nothing."
Muramasa《!? Wh-what!》
Muramasa II"From the beginning, my father had considered both sides. Front and back."
Muramasa II"Front: an ordinary pilot understands the Balance of Good and Evil, spreads it through the world. Good. Back: despite being bound by the law, the pilot kills and kills, without discrimination. That also, good."
Muramasa II"Seeing that, people would understand for themselves the sin of violence."
Muramasa《...!!》
Muramasa II"Now the depth of my father's thinking you understand?"
Muramasa II"Whatever sort of person the pilot is... we Muramasa can fulfil our wish. Show the world the truth of war and violence!"

Muramasa II"Human beings, incorrigible creatures. Even the disaster of the two Courts taught them nothing."
Muramasa II"Until the edge of extinction they reach, understanding will not come! No... at this point, even extinction we may accept."
Muramasa II"People gone, fighting gone. My father's wish is fulfilled!!"
Muramasa《————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————》
